decks.name: LeetCode #4 - Median of Two Sorted Arrays
decks.description: Find the median of two sorted arrays with optimal time complexity

cards.question: Median of Two Sorted Arrays: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2 of size m and n respectively, return the median of the two sorted arrays. The overall run time complexity should be O(log (m+n)).

solutions.name: Binary Search (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Binary search on the smaller array to find the correct partition point where left half elements are all less than right half elements. Use partition indices to find median elements efficiently. Most optimal with O(log(min(m,n))) time and O(1) space.

solutions.name: Binary Search (Recursive)
solutions.explanation: Recursively find the k-th smallest element by eliminating half of one array in each step. For median, find elements at positions (m+n+1)/2 and (m+n+2)/2, then average. Elegant divide-and-conquer approach.
